episodes.synopsis: The members of the 501st Joint Fighter Wing are humanity's greatest defense against the Neuroi threat. These rare and valuable records show a side of them you’ve never seen before…
episodes.title: 501st, Take Off!

episodes.synopsis: Hartmann's filthy room is to the point where it's out of control. The rest of the 501st comes to clean it, but finds things are worse than they feared.
episodes.title: 501st, Clean Your Dirty Rooms?

episodes.synopsis: It's payday, and payday means a shopping trip! But going into town to shop means getting in a car with speed demon Charlotte...
episodes.title: 501st, Head Out To Shop?

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Halloween, and the witches are ready to play tricks and get treats. But some doors are better left undisturbed...
episodes.title: 501st, It's Time For Halloween?

episodes.synopsis: Mio's hair is getting a little long, but is it safe to let anybody in the 501st cut it?
episodes.title: 501st, Time For A Haircut?

episodes.synopsis: War is tough, but Miyafuji is ready to solve everybody's stress-related problems.
episodes.title: 501st, Are You Feeling Stressed?

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the Fuso holiday of Setsubun, and that means it's time for throwing beans, and eating yummy Fuso food!
episodes.title: 501st, Get Ready for Setsubun?

episodes.synopsis: The Neuroi are coming tonight, which means that everybody needs to stay up! How will they stay awake, though?
episodes.title: 501st, Get Ready for Night Work?

episodes.synopsis: Miyafuji's lost the ability to fly. Has she put on weight from eating everybody's food?
episodes.title: 501st, You Can't Fly Anymore?

episodes.synopsis: It's the middle of summer, and everybody's burning up! How do they beat the heat?
episodes.title: 501st, Are You Feeling the Heat?

episodes.synopsis: Hartmann may look like a lazy slacker, but she's actually working really hard to learn to be a doctor! Now she wants to teach the others to do CPR, but...
episodes.title: 501st, Time to Save Lives?

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the final battle, and the 501st isn't invited! Instead, they'll be taking a nice, safe vacation on a tropical island...
episodes.title: 501st, You're Splitting Up?
